summary.en: Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East dominates premarket action as Trump's Hormuz toll and Iran blockade lift oil prices above $85/bbl, pushing U.S. Treasury yields to two-month highs while broadening tech sector weakness from memory chip demand concerns.
summary.zh: 中东地缘政治升级主导盘前交易，特朗普霍尔木兹海峡收费和伊朗港口封锁推动油价突破 85 美元/桶美油；通胀预期升温抬升美国国债收益率至两个月高位；大科技股受存储芯片需求担忧拖累普遍走弱。

title.en: Trump announces Hormuz shipping fees and Iran port blockade, lifting WTI oil to $79.91 (+2.3%) amid supply disruption fears
title.zh: 特朗普宣布霍尔木兹海峡航运费并重启伊朗港口封锁，美油期货涨至 79.91 美元/桶（+2.3%），市场对供应中断担加剧

impact.en: Supply shock premium widens as Strait of Hormuz traffic concerns materialize; one-fifth of global crude supply at risk, pushing inflation hedge demand and broadening energy rally
impact.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡交通风险兑现，供应冲击溢价扩大；全球原油五分之一储量受威胁，通胀避险需求升温带动能源板块普涨

macroRisk.en: Yes - Oil → Inflation expectations ↑ → 10Y Treasury yields to ~4.62%; Dollar strength via safe-haven flows; Potential Fed rate pause reconsideration if inflation resurges
macroRisk.zh: 是：油价上涨推升通胀预期，美债收益率升至约 4.62%；避险资金流向美元强化 DXY；若通胀重燃或迫美联储重新考虑暂停加息

title.en: AI chip stocks tumble: SK Hynix debut sparks sector-wide selloff; NVDA, AMD, Broadcom all in red as memory demand concerns spread
title.zh: AI 芯片股重挫：SK 海力士 NASDAQ 上市引发板块抛售；NVDA、AMD、Broadcom 悉数转跌，存储需求担忧蔓延

impact.en: Memory chip pullback reflects cyclical demand reset and profit-taking after recent surge; equipment makers (ASML, LRCX) also weakened ahead of earnings
impact.zh: 内存芯片回落体现周期性需求重置及近期上涨后的获利了结；设备股（ASML、Lam Research）业绩前也走弱

macroRisk.en: Yes - Semiconductor capex slowdown concerns could cascade to broader tech valuations if inventory rebalancing persists beyond mid-term election cycle
macroRisk.zh: 是：半导体资本开支放缓担忧可能扩散至大盘科技估值，若库存再平衡超出中期选举周期

title.en: DXY surges and Gold drops below $4,000 as U.S. Central Command completes Middle East strikes; inflation hedge rotation intensifies
title.zh: 美元走强黄金跌破 4000 美元，美军中东打击行动完成；通胀对冲交易加剧

impact.en: Dollar strength flows into USD as geopolitical safe-haven asset priced in oil shock; Gold underpressure from higher real yields and stronger currency amid conflict escalation
impact.zh: 地缘避险+油价冲击定价下资金涌入美元；黄金受实际收益率攀升和强势货币压制

macroRisk.en: Yes - Higher USD suppresses EM equities; Gold rotation to real assets if inflation fears persist beyond temporary shock window
macroRisk.zh: 是：强势美元压制新兴市场股票；若通胀担忧超过暂时冲击窗口，黄金将流向实物资产

title.en: Bond yields rise on geopolitical risk premium: 10Y Treasury holds near two-month highs as oil-driven inflation expectations reprice
title.zh: 美债收益率受地缘风险溢价推升：10 年期国债维持在两个月高位，油价驱动通胀预期重定价

impact.en: Higher yields pressure rate-sensitive growth stocks; flight-to-quality in Treasuries but yield curve steepens as inflation re-enters pricing models
impact.zh: 收益率上行施压利率敏感型成长股；避险国债买入但长端收益率在通胀预期回归定价模型后走陡

bearish: XLP growth rotation away from tech

macroRisk.en: Yes - Yield curve inflation hedge becomes material if supply shocks persist; Fed policy stance recalibration risk on sustained oil premium
macroRisk.zh: 是：若供应冲击持续，收益率曲线通胀对冲将实质性显现；油价溢价持久化或迫使美联储政策立场重新校准

title.en: Market breadth deteriorates as Japan/Korea/Australia trading weighs on U.S. futures; mixed sentiment amid selective energy rallies
title.zh: 日本/韩国/澳洲交易拖累美股期指，市场广度恶化；能源板块选择性走强下情绪分化

impact.en: Overseas Asian markets drag down premarket positioning despite selective strength in defense and energy sectors; S&P futures point lower into open
impact.zh: 亚洲海外市场拖累盘前布局，尽管防御与能源板块表现选择性走强；标普期指低开

macroRisk.en: Yes - Geopolitical risk premium persists; Selective rallies vulnerable if oil spike triggers broader inflation spiral
macroRisk.zh: 是：地缘风险溢价持续；若油价飙升引发更广泛通胀螺旋，选择性反弹将受挫

title.en: U.S. strikes on Iranian military targets complete per CENTCOM; Tehran retaliates against Gulf neighbors including UAE and Bahrain
title.zh: 美军完成对伊朗军事目标打击；德黑兰报复攻击阿联酋巴林等海湾邻国

impact.en: Escalation loop widens conflict scope beyond immediate oil choke points; Long-term regional instability reinforces premium on energy inflation hedge
impact.zh: 升级循环扩大冲突范围超越即时油气咽喉；长期区域不稳定强化能源通胀避险溢价

macroRisk.en: Yes - Regional war spillover could force sustained oil supply constraints; Energy inflation feeds back into Fed rate expectations
macroRisk.zh: 是：区域战争外溢可能迫使能源供应持续受限；能源通胀反馈至美联储加息预期

title.en: Analysts warn Trump's Hormuz toll proposal raises military escalation risk; Citi cites higher-for-longer oil prices under Iranian regime exit MoU scenario
title.zh: 分析师警告特朗普霍尔木兹收费提案加剧军事升级风险；花旗称若伊朗政权退出协议，油价将维持高位

impact.en: Market pricing in sustained higher energy costs; Equity valuations pressured unless inflation stays contained within Fed policy window
impact.zh: 市场定价为持续较高的能源成本；除非通胀控制在美联储政策窗口内，否则股票估值受压

macroRisk.en: Yes - Escalation risk keeps oil elevated; If supply disruptions persist, Fed may pause hikes or pivot faster to avoid recession
macroRisk.zh: 是：升级风险维持油价高位；若供应中断持续，美联储或暂停加息更快转向避免衰退

title.en: Chip equipment makers weaken: ASML, Applied Materials, LRCX, KLAC all down ~3% as semiconductor sector sentiment deteriorates
title.zh: 芯片设备股走弱：ASML、AppliedMaterials、Lam Research 和 KLA 均跌约 3%，半导体板块情绪恶化

impact.en: Memory chip demand reset + profit-taking from recent AI rally; Capital expenditure cycle concerns cascade through supply chain
impact.zh: 存储芯片需求重置+AI 近期热潮后的获利了结；资本开支周期担忧通过产业链传导

macroRisk.en: Yes - Semiconductor downturn risk feeds into broader tech sector; Cyclical inventory imbalance could prolong weakness beyond earnings recovery
macroRisk.zh: 是：半导体下行风险传导至大盘科技；周期性库存失衡可能使弱势持续超出业绩复苏期

ai.en: Weakness broadened from SK hynix debut across memory/AI chip sector; NVDA, AMD lead selloff as cyclical demand concerns and profit-taking compound post-listing volatility.
ai.zh: 弱势从SK海力士上市扩散至存储/芯片板块；NVDA、AMD领先抛售，周期性需求担忧和盘后获利了结叠加上市后波动。

semiconductor.en: Broad-based weakness: Equipment makers down 3% on memory demand reset; ASML faces earnings ahead. TSMC also pressured despite strong sales growth (QoQ+36%), reflecting sector-wide inventory rebalancing.
semiconductor.zh: 板块性走弱：设备股跌3%源于存储需求重置；ASML面临业绩。台积电虽销售增长强劲但亦受压制，反映全行业库存再平衡。

bigTech.en: Selective pressure; Big Tech names trade softer amid rate sensitivity as 10Y yield represses growth valuations. Cloud/AI monetization remain secular tailwinds but near-term volatility elevated.
bigTech.zh: 选择性承压；大科技股受利率敏感拖累，10年期收益率压制成长估值。云/AI变现仍是长期顺风但短期波动加剧。

energy.en: Strong performer as geopolitical shock premium dominates; WTI+$80, Brent near$86. Citi warns of escalation risk; Sector rally supported by sustained supply constraints narrative.
energy.zh: 强势品种地缘冲击溢价主导；WTI超 80 美元，布伦特近 86 美元。花旗警告升级风险；板块反弹得到供应约束叙事支撑。

ev.en: Neutral to cautiously negative given oil price spike impacts margin outlook; EV sector correlates with auto manufacturing macro regime rather than direct geopolitical impact on supply chain.
ev.zh: 中性至谨慎负面，因油价飙升影响盈利前景；电动车板块与汽车制造宏观体制相关而非供应链直接地缘冲击。

market.en: Broad market mixed with defensive rotation; S&P futures point down from Asian session weakness. Energy rallies but tech breadth deteriorates amid supply chain/inventory concerns.
market.zh: 大盘分化防御性轮动；标普期指受亚洲走弱下点跌。能源上涨但科技广度恶化，供应链库存担忧拖累。

preciousMetals.en: Gold underperforms at < $4000 as real yields climb with USD strength; Silver follows. Flight-to-safety limited by dollar pricing-in of oil shock premium.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金表现弱于 4000 美元下实际收益率攀升；白银跟随。避险资金流向受油价冲击溢价定价为美元压制限制。

oil.en: Surge over+9% driven by Trump's Hormuz toll and Iran port blockade; U.S. strikes complete but escalation risks priced in. WTI at$79.91, Brent near $86.
oil.zh: 暴涨 9%以上受特朗普霍尔木兹收费和伊朗港口封锁驱动；美军打击完成但升级风险已定价。WTI 在 79.91 美元，布伦特近 86 美元。

futures.en: S&P500 futures -0.3% lower from Asian markets; Nasdaq neutral amid tech sector divergence
futures.zh: 标普期指受亚洲市场拖累低约-0.3%；纳斯达克中性，科技股板块分化

treasury10Y.en: ~4.62%, up 5 basis points on oil-driven inflation expectations; Yield curve steepens as rate-sensitive stocks pressured
treasury10Y.zh: 约 4.62%，油价驱动通胀预期抬升上行 5bp；收益率曲线走陡利率敏感型股票承压

dxy.en: USD up vs EUR/JPY on oil shock safe-haven flows; DXY strength continues into premarket trading
dxy.zh: 油价冲击避险资金推动美元对欧元日元走强；盘前交易美元继续强势

oil.en: $79.8-80 range for WTI ahead of open, extended gains from Middle East escalation; Brent ~$85
oil.zh: 开盘前WTI在 79.8-80美元区间，中东升级后延续涨势；布伦特近 85 美元

keyRisk.en: Sustained oil premium forcing Fed policy recalibration; if inflation reemerges, rate cut timeline shifts earlier than expected
keyRisk.zh: 油价溢价持久化迫使美联储政策重新校准；若通胀重现，降息时点将比预期提前

note.en: Energy rally offsets tech weakness; Mixed sentiment due to geopolitical risk premium dominating broader market direction. Oil → inflation ↑→ yields up is the primary transmission channel today.
note.zh: 能源反弹抵消科技疲软；情绪分化因地缘风险溢价主导大盘方向。今日主要传导逻辑：油价→通胀↑→收益率上行

_meta_.uncertaintiesNotable: Real-time DXY value delayed; some Nasdaq data unavailable per web sources
